caption:
The rocket that reaches orbit was preceded by a hundred versions that never left the ground - none of them were the failure, all of them were the job.

Growth doesn't look like progress from the inside. It looks like repeated attempts nobody outside is watching. Whatever you're rebuilding today for the third or tenth time is still moving, even when it doesn't feel like it.
